messages.content:
A person asked this in the Slack thread of an incident Argus is responding to:

what has Argus done about this so far?

This is everything Argus has recorded about the incident, oldest first:

- 2026-10-25T22:43:02Z Argus: Received HighErrorRate on io-shop
- 2026-10-25T22:43:02Z Argus: Moved the incident to INVESTIGATING - a worker took the incident up
- 2026-10-25T22:43:03Z Argus: Called in the Investigator Agent
- 2026-10-25T22:43:03Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's per-minute metrics, anchored on 22:43
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 361 minutes of metrics
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Placed the start of the incident at 22:37
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Recorded where the 3 replicas run - all on Tesla-V100-SXM2-16GB
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Asked for production change events - deploys, releases and flag changes on the service, the 1 day before Oct 25 22:37
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 1 production change
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Read how far the deployment had rolled out - all 3 replicas run one revision, which the history does not name
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's log lines, the 36 minutes before 22:43
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 133 log lines
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Formed 1 candidate cause, best first: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on at 22:37. Account page requests that take the new spend-summary path now fail with ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and the error rate stepped from about 1% to about 30%. No deployment landed and the replicas are on one revision.
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Investigator Agent: Read every channel available
- 2026-10-25T22:43:04Z Argus: Read the flag provider's history - 1 flag change by anyone but Argus, the 1 hour before 22:43:04
- 2026-10-25T22:43:05Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATING to act on the leading candidate
- 2026-10-25T22:43:05Z Argus: Called in the Mitigation Agent
- 2026-10-25T22:43:05Z Mitigation Agent: Reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature, moved from ON to OFF
- 2026-10-25T22:43:07Z Mitigation Agent: Waiting to see whether the service is still at the incident's level, from 22:44 - up to 120s
- 2026-10-25T22:43:07Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - still at the incident's level
- 2026-10-25T22:45:03Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - no longer at the incident's level since 22:43
- 2026-10-25T22:45:03Z Mitigation Agent: Judged the action CONFIRMED
- 2026-10-25T22:45:03Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATED - set flag [monthly-spend-feature] OFF and the rule that fired stopped firing
- 2026-10-25T22:45:11Z Code-Fix Agent: Proposed a fix as a draft pull request - https://github.com/ohadraz/Argus-Demo-Target-App/pull/352
- 2026-10-25T22:45:11Z Argus: Filed what was tried on this incident: putting monthly-spend-feature back
- 2026-10-25T22:45:12Z Postmortem Agent: Wrote the postmortem - The service broke at 22:37 UTC and was back to normal at 22:44 UTC, 7 minutes later. 28.2% of requests failed while it was broken, against 1.0% before it began. At its worst, 37.0% failed. The shop's takings fell short of the same hours on earlier weeks by 4,246.73 USD, beyond how much those hours vary on their own. Switching on a new monthly spending summary sent shoppers' account pages through a calculation that divided by zero, likely because shoppers who had bought before but not yet this month had no purchases this month to divide by. What Argus did: reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature (can be put back) - confirmed, still in place. Argus opened a draft fix, PR #352, for a person to review and merge. The division by zero is still in the code with the flag off, so switching monthly-spend-feature back on would likely make account pages fail again for shoppers who have bought before but not yet this month.

Answer only from these lines. Where they do not hold the answer, say that the record does not say, rather than guessing. Do not say Argus will do anything; answer what happened.

Call submit_answer with your answer.
